title: 7 Rules For An Effective Meeting Culture
summary: Seven practical rules for establishing effective meeting culture: be on time, prepared, engaged, a good listener, inclusive, accountable, and reasonable; supported by specific tactics for meeting chairs and attendees.
when-to-read: Read this when you're looking to improve how your team or organization runs meetings, or when you want to understand what makes meetings productive and respectful for everyone involved. If you need guidance on structuring the purpose and attendee selection of individual meetings, consult the related two-part guide on meeting effectiveness instead.
